title: 英文句子的基本结构
goal: 按基本句型排列句子主干；补足谓语所需的句子成分。

points.label: 按基本句型排列句子主干
补足谓语所需的句子成分

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 英文句子的基本结构的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 句子主干由谓语动词决定：动词需要哪些成分，主干就有哪些成分。主语后面必须有能单独作谓语的动词。名词短语和单独的 -ing 形式都不能作谓语。

body.box: The students near the seminar room discussed the topic before their afternoon class began.

body.p: near the seminar room 修饰 students，discussed 是谓语。宾语是动作的对象，表语说明主语，宾语补足语说明宾语。

cards.title: 五种基本句型
rows: 主谓
动词后不接宾语，可加状语说明时间、地点。
The students laughed together when the drama club performed a short scene during lunch.
主谓宾
动词后必须接宾语，说明动作的对象。
The librarian checked the returned books before placing them on the shelf near the entrance.
主系表
系动词后接表语。表语用形容词，不用副词。
The rehearsal room became quiet when the student conductor raised a hand to begin.
主谓双宾语
give、show 等动词后先接接受者，再接事物。
The course assistant gave each student a printed timetable before the first laboratory session.
主谓宾补
补足语说明宾语的状态或身份，不是给出的东西。
The class elected Mina team leader after discussing the responsibilities of the new role.

cards.title: 句型与成分
rows: 主谓
Several students waited outside the lecture room until the previous class had finished.
waited 是谓语，outside the lecture room 是地点状语。
主谓宾
The student representative collected written suggestions about the proposed changes to the campus courtyard.
collected 的宾语是 written suggestions。
主系表
The instructions seemed clear to the students after the instructor demonstrated the equipment.
clear 是形容词表语，不用 clearly。
主谓双宾语
The tutor showed the new students a sample report before explaining the assessment criteria.
students 是接受者，report 是事物。
主谓宾补
The extra practice made the student speakers more confident about presenting their group project.
more confident 说明 speakers 的状态。

cards.title: 必需成分与残句
rows: 缺谓语
The map on the classroom wall.
The map on the classroom wall shows the locations of all the campus buildings.
只有主语和修饰语，没有谓语。
缺限定动词
The volunteers preparing name cards.
The volunteers are preparing name cards for participants arriving at the student conference today.
preparing 前面加 are 才能作谓语。
缺宾语
The committee discussed after lunch.
The committee discussed the new timetable after lunch in the main student meeting room.
discuss 后面要接讨论的对象。
缺表语
The explanation became.
The explanation became clearer after the tutor added an example from a familiar situation.
become 是系动词，后面要接表语。
缺宾补
The changes made the instructions.
The changes made the instructions clearer for students using the equipment for the first time.
make 表示使宾语处于某种状态，后面要接宾补。
误用双宾语
The tutor explained us the task.
The tutor explained the task to us before the group started preparing its response.
explain 不接双宾语，人要用 to 引出。

body.box: Context: A campus astronomy society has selected a coordinator for its observation evening. The choice is based on experience with organizing student groups, rather than on technical knowledge alone. Draft: The society appointed Lian. Intended meaning: Lian now has the role of coordinator for the evening.

body.p: appointed Lian 只说任命了 Lian，没有说出职务。加上补足语 coordinator，说明 Lian 的身份。coordinator 不是交给 Lian 的物品。

body.box: The society appointed Lian coordinator of the observation evening after comparing the candidates' organizational experience.

body.p: The society gave Lian a schedule 中，schedule 是给 Lian 的东西，这句是双宾语。判断看两个成分的关系：后者说明前者的身份或状态，是宾补；后者是给出的东西，是双宾语。

items.stem: In 'The campus debate ended after the final speaker answered the last question', what is the main clause pattern?
options: Subject and intransitive verb
Subject, linking verb and complement
Subject, verb and two objects
Subject, verb, object and complement
items.why: The campus debate ended 是主谓主干，after 从句补充时间。

items.stem: Which version completes a sentence with 'discuss' meaning to examine a topic together?
options: The student panel discussed in the meeting room after the afternoon lecture.
The student panel discussed the proposal in the meeting room after the lecture.
The student panel discussing the proposal in the meeting room after the lecture.
The student panel the proposal in the meeting room after the afternoon lecture.
items.why: discussed the proposal 既有谓语，又有宾语，句子完整，即第二项。第一项缺讨论的对象。

items.stem: In 'The new lighting made the rehearsal space brighter', what is 'brighter'?
options: The second object of the verb made
The object receiving the action
The complement describing the object
The complement describing the subject
items.why: brighter 说明 the rehearsal space 的状态，是宾语补足语，即第三项。第四项错在 brighter 说明的不是主语 lighting。

items.stem: Use the adjective 'clear' to complete the linking-verb pattern: The revised instructions seem ___ to the new members.
items.why: seem 是系动词，后接形容词 clear 作表语。

groups.text: A student exhibition team has revised its visitor leaflet. Draft notes read: The new leaflet very useful. It includes a map and a short description of each display. The coordinator gave every guide a copy. The team considers the current layout suitable for visitors who arrive without a guide.

items.stem: Which repair supplies the missing predicate in the first note?
options: The new leaflet being very useful for visitors during the exhibition.
The new leaflet very useful for visitors during the exhibition.
The new leaflet is very useful for visitors during the exhibition.
The new leaflet with very useful information for visitors during the exhibition.
items.why: The new leaflet very useful 缺系动词，is 构成主系表。

items.stem: State what the coordinator gave the guides.
items.why: gave 是限定谓语，every guide 是接受者，a copy of the revised leaflet 是给予物。

items.stem: State the team's judgment about the layout.
items.why: suitable 是说明 layout 的形容词宾补，suitably 是副词。

groups.text: A campus science fair uses student hosts to introduce simple demonstrations. The organizer has prepared a booklet explaining each station. Draft: The booklet on the registration table. It contains descriptions of the demonstrations. The organizer gave each host a copy. The hosts found the descriptions useful when preparing their introductions.

items.stem: Which revision turns the first draft fragment into a complete statement?
options: The booklet on the registration table describes the stations used at the fair.
The booklet on the registration table describing the stations used at the fair.
The booklet on the registration table with descriptions of the fair's stations.
The booklet on the registration table and the descriptions of the fair's stations.
items.why: 原句 The booklet on the registration table 只是名词短语。第一项加上谓语 describes，句子完整。

items.stem: What is the pattern of 'The hosts found the descriptions useful'?
options: Subject, linking verb and subject complement
Subject, verb, object and object complement
Subject, verb and two separate objects
Subject and verb with no object
items.why: the descriptions 是宾语，useful 说明它们的性质，是宾补。

items.stem: State the organizer's action with the booklet.
items.why: gave 后依次是接受者和给予物，giving 不能独立构成谓语。

items.stem: Use the past-simple form of 'be' to supply the missing linking verb: The booklet ___ useful during yesterday's science fair.
items.why: 主语 The booklet 是单数，题干要求过去式，用 was 连接主语和 useful。

groups.text: A student sound-recording group is preparing a campus audio guide. Its members check the script before recording. Draft: The group discussed in the editing room. The intended topic was the opening paragraph. Later, the director played a test recording, and the voices sounded natural to the other group members.

items.stem: Which addition supplies the object required by 'discussed'?
options: The group discussed carefully in the editing room before the scheduled recording.
The group discussed after lunch in the editing room before the scheduled recording.
The group discussed the opening paragraph in the editing room before the recording.
The group discussed with great care in the editing room before the recording.
items.why: discussed 缺讨论的对象。第三项加上宾语 the opening paragraph，其余各项加的都是状语。

items.stem: In 'The voices sounded natural', which analysis is correct?
options: The voices receive natural as a second object of sounded.
The voices act on natural as the object of sounded.
The voices and natural are two objects following sounded.
The voices are described by natural after the linking verb sounded.
items.why: sounded 是系动词，意为听起来。natural 说明 voices，是表语，即第四项。

items.stem: Describe the effect of the revision on the introduction.
items.why: made 后接宾语 the introduction 和形容词宾补 more accessible。accessibly 是副词，不能说明宾语的状态。

items.stem: Complete the stated subject–verb–object sentence with the given noun 'script': The members checked the ___ before the recording session began.
items.why: checked 是及物动词，后接宾语 the script。
